description: Alpha events: stories flagged ahead of the wider press, newest first. Each event has a country, coordinates, an alpha_kind, an alpha_score, the rationale, and the quorum on the story when one exists. Filter by country or by a geohash map cell. Costs $0.02 per event returned; an empty page is free. Needs the Quorumz API key on this connection (Authorization: Bearer <key>); the first 100 calls within 7 days are free.

cell.description: Geohash map cell of precision 3 to 5 (e.g. sy10, around Beirut), to keep only events inside it.
cell.title: Cell

country.description: ISO 3166 alpha-2 country code, e.g. LB. Omit for the whole world.
country.title: Country

cursor.description: next_cursor of the previous page, to read older records. Omit for the newest.
cursor.title: Cursor

limit.description: Records per page, 1 to 50. Every record returned is charged.
limit.title: Limit

name: list_alpha_events
title: List alpha events
